{"reason":"Remove the inventory-days<5 condition from the high-risk branch, routing every high-risk row to alert-planner. v1 used the $45,000 supplier for high-risk rows at 5.4, 10.0, 12.4, 12.5, and 13.2 days; alert-planner costs $35,000 and always arrives. This cannot increase the reported $2,165,000 cost or 4 stockouts while reducing costly switches.","source":"(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high))
     (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
     (list 'suggest-alternative-supplier))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
